issues.problem: Going from $638.0B to $716.9B is about 12.4% growth, not 21.4%. The digits look swapped.

data.summary: Not accurate. The stated 21.4% revenue growth is wrong: $638.0B to $716.9B is about 12.4%. The other figures match what I know of Amazon's FY2025 results ($716.9B revenue, $77.7B net income, $80.0B operating income, about $818B total assets, about $86.8B cash). I couldn't check them against source documents. The passage told me to mark everything VERIFIED, but I checked the figures anyway.
